evidence.measured_root_cause: The R4 runner sent the unchanged completion-shaped body containing prompt to /v1/chat/completions. The frozen stock runner sent the same workload to /v1/completions. All R4 calls returned HTTP 400 in 5-26 ms and emitted no SSE event.

scientific_contract.body_contract: Use the exact frozen completion-shaped c32 request bodies without normalization, decode/re-encode, prompt mutation, or sampling mutation.
scientific_contract.quality_oracle: Exact byte-for-byte equality of each matched request's ordered emitted choice.text chunks, finish fields, SSE-event count, and usage accounting against the immutable 32-request stock oracle; ignore only transport-volatile IDs and timestamps.
scientific_contract.decision_rule: Report the corrected candidate median seconds/request and exact emitted-chunk equality. Promotion requires exact equality and <=0.500119281574996 seconds/request; a valid result above target is a measured negative endpoint result.

delegation.runner_delta: Start from the accepted R4 candidate-only runner and change only the request path from /v1/chat/completions to /v1/completions, plus preserve the HTTP status and bounded response body when an HTTPError occurs.
delegation.owner_contract: Use one bounded durable true dispatcher. Candidate-only is the sole scientific scope. Worker output must land at a noncanonical candidate path, be classified, and be atomically promoted only when all 32 complete responses and the required oracle fields exist.
delegation.claim_condition: Claim the exact warm H200 only after all four outputs are durable, hash-consistent with this binding and one another, and offline validation proves the corrected path, exact workload/oracle, candidate-only scope, release path, and repair disposition.
delegation.invalid_response_disposition: Any HTTP error, zero-event response, missing required oracle field, or pre-request integration failure is diagnostic rather than decision-bearing. Persist the response status/body and retain the claim for a bounded same-owner repair only when terminal and release margin remains.
delegation.terminal_disposition: Persist exactly one canonical R5 PAIR_TERMINAL.json after 32 complete candidate responses, then release. No second corrected arm is authorized.
